content.text: If you're from a country where Stripe, PayPal, or other payment processors are restricted, deploying a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-2|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages for free is not just a hack, but the only way to truly own your commerce infrastructure. In this post, we'll dive into the real [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-online-without-gumroad-3|The Real]]s between two options: Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) and Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-3|supabase]] + NOWPayments). With millions of people being locked out of mainstream payment processors, it's time to look at what's actually available and what works.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01 is a basic setup that relies on GitHub Pages for hosting, Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This stack is free to deploy and maintain, with 3 products loaded, 30-day support, and a total fee of 0.5% for every transaction. It's perfect for small creators who want to get started quickly. On the other hand, Stack 02 is a more advanced setup that uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This stack is also free to deploy and maintain, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, end-to-end tested, and a total fee of 0.5% for every transaction. It's ideal for larger creators who need more features and scalability.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both Stack 01 and Stack 02 are designed to handle restricted countries by using NOWPayments as a payment processor. This means that you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with no KYC or buyer account required. However, it's worth noting that some countries may still have restrictions or limitations on certain payment methods, so it's essential to check with NOWPayments before deploying your store. In contrast, Stack 02 has an additional advantage of being deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, which ensures that your store is set up correctly and securely from the start.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, both Stack 01 and Stack 02 can process payments in real-time, with no delays or holdups. However, the fees and real costs of each stack are different. Stack 01 has a total fee of 0.5% for every transaction, while Stack 02 also has a total fee of 0.5% for every transaction. But, with Stack 02, you get more features and scalability, which can ultimately save you money in the long run. Additionally, Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, which means that you can focus on selling your products without worrying about the technical details.
Stack 01 is perfect for small creators who want to get started quickly and easily.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the biggest advantages of both Stack 01 and Stack 02 is that you own everything after deployment. This means that you have complete control over your commerce infrastructure and can make changes or updates as needed. Both stacks also automate payment processing, order storage, and delivery, which saves you time and effort. However, Stack 02 has an additional advantage of being end-to-end tested before handoff, which ensures that your store is set up correctly and securely from the start.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between Stack 01 and Stack 02 ultimately depends on your specific situation and needs. If you're a small creator who wants to get started quickly and easily, Stack 01 may be the best option. However, if you're a larger creator who needs more features and scalability, Stack 02 is the way to go. Additionally, if you're looking for a more advanced setup with end-to-end testing and 30-day support, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is also an option to consider.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages with either Stack 01 or Stack 02, follow these steps: First, choose the stack that best fits your needs and budget. Next, sign up for a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account and set up your hosting environment. Then, configure your payment processor with NOWPayments and set up your order storage with Supabase. Finally, deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages and test it thoroughly before going live.
